summary.en: HUTB's official 2026 guide identifies a one-academic-year scholarship for language students from Belt and Road countries. It does not itemize the amount or a separate deadline.
summary.zh: 湖南工商大学官方2026简章明确设有面向“一带一路”沿线国家语言生的一学年奖学金，但未分项公布金额或单独截止日期。
summary.ru: Официальное руководство HUTB 2026 подтверждает годовую стипендию для языковых студентов стран «Пояса и пути», но не указывает сумму или отдельный срок.

exclusions.reason: WTU's current notice index confirms a December 2025 Hubei Provincial International Student Scholarship selection, but the retained page did not expose enough current scope and funding detail for a safe new candidate; the scholarship was withheld rather than inferred.

Domestic admission catalogs, outbound mobility programs, third-party aggregators and programs not explicitly tied to inbound international applicants were excluded. Closed cycles remain visible only as historical evidence and are never marked open.
